Comment: Proposed Service Line workflow. Custom resources require an unimplemented runtime; this file is not an executable integration.

Research.Comment: Agent step, read-only. The implementer maps the code, project rules, and lessons that apply.

Plan.Comment: Agent step. The plan lists scope, phases, checks, and a risk level (low, medium, high) with reasons. Approval binds it.

ReviewPlan.Comment: Agent step, read-only, run by the verifier. Findings are attached to the plan; the verifier cannot change it.

Implement.Comment: Agent step. One plan phase at a time, with a checkpoint commit after each. Ends early on a guard: repeated call, no progress, or time limit.

RunChecks.Comment: Engine step. Format, lint, build, and the checks the service guide requires for the approved risk level.

Review.Comment: Agent step, run by the verifier. Exercises the service, runs hidden scenarios, and reviews the diff. Cannot edit the code.

Evaluate.Comment: Engine step. Requires complete, current evidence and the human review assigned to the approved risk level before a pass.

Repair.Comment: Agent step. Finds the cause, repairs inside the approved scope, and returns a new snapshot. Old evidence is discarded.

Ready.Comment: Ready for review. After a recorded deployment, post-deploy-observe can start as a second run.

NeedsAttention.Cause: Required evidence is missing, inconclusive, or the repair limit is reached.
